text:
Danny: quick heads up 00: we had user reports that a canary fallback consumed a huge chunk of their monthly quota last night. can we define clear semantics so billing + ops aren't surprised?
Kavya: ouch. current behavior is vague: router delivers fallback, we mark as served, billing counts both attempts in some edge cases.
Ibrahim: concrete proposal: attach a canonical_request_id that follows retries/fallbacks. billing dedupe will use canonical_request_id and a deterministic winner selection (first responder unless org opts into prefer-primary).
Zoë: UI needs: show "grace tokens left" and a small icon when dedupe is pending. also surface when an org uses prefer-primary billing.
Marta: +audit: any manual change to charge policy or grace tokens must create an immutable audit entry with actor, justification, and reason code. security insists on no model payloads in those events.
Danny: also think about payback semantics: if dedupe later reduces bill, does customer get immediate credit or next invoice adjustment? Finance input required.
billing-bot: finance: please advise on retro credit vs invoice adjustment. tagged finance-team.
Kavya: sampling/telemetry: we want lightweight decision tags on every router event: decision=[primary|fallback|quarantine], reason=[timeout|oom|rate_limit|policy], policy_id. small and off by default.
Ibrahim: sampling idea: "pulse sampling" - when fallback_rate(route) spikes, we pulse high sampling (traces) for a short window and then decay. prevents long-term cost while still giving SRE evidence during incidents.
Zoë: pulse UI: rollout card shows small pulse animation when sampling is high and a tooltip: "sampling high for 12m due to 3.2% fallback rate". operator can mute sampling per-rollout.
Marta: operator overrides: Pause fallback routing for a rollout. pressing Pause requires justification and creates audit event. overrides auto-expire after X minutes unless explicitly extended. also rate-limit overrides per-org.
Danny: how do we prevent abuse of grace budgets? customers might flip rollouts to exploit free tokens. propose per-org cooldown + a cooldown displayed in UI when grace applied.
Kavya: add a grace_budget ledger line: when rollout created with grace_tokens, write ledger entry so Finance can reconcile. show remaining balance on rollout page and export.
Ibrahim: implementation sketch: gateway sets header X-Canonical-Req, router emits metric fallback_count(route,org) and a control-plane job toggles sampler for route when thresholds hit. pseudocode:
```
if fallback_count(route,60s) > 5:
  set_sampler(route, "high", 900)  # 15m
```
Zoë: audit retention: how long do we keep decision traces? compliance wants 1y, but traces are heavy. idea: keep decision metadata (mode/reason/policy) in audit log for 1y, keep full sampled traces for 90d.
Marta: agree on metadata retention 1y, redact PII. any full trace must be opt-in and only accessible to roles with privilege.
Danny: billing dedupe edge: what about client-side retries that change request_id? Canonical header must be set at gateway first touch to avoid gaps. Liam (networking) will need to help.
Ibrahim: corner case: transient fallbacks that return canned one-line while primary later returns long output. canonical decision: bill first responder but dedupe to single charge. org-level opt-in for prefer-primary if contract requires it.
Zoë: add small timeline event when dedupe runs: "dedupe applied: -12.4k tokens" with ledger id link. helpful for ops + customer support.
Marta: manual adjustments need 2FA for amounts > threshold and create audit entries with reason. also require a justification message in UI.
billing-bot: note recorded: created PLAT-6500 "canonical-id + pulse-sampling + grace-ledger + audit-retention" assigned to infra and billing. staging target next Wednesday.
Danny: next steps: Ibrahim to spec header + router tags; Kavya to draft pulse sampling tuning (thresholds/decay); Zoë to mock UI + ledger row; Marta to write audit schema and retention policy; finance to confirm credit behavior. sync Thurs 10am.
Kavya: I'll post tuning proposal here.
Ibrahim: I'll include migration plan and feature flag.
Marta: thanks all, this should make billing less surprising for customers.
Zoë: posting quick mock in #design when ready :eyes:
Danny: thanks team. any objections?
Kavya: none from infra.
Marta: all good.
